gk.spin_side.words: in full side profile, his whole body facing the right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin. We see his face in profile with one eye, his nose and thin mustache pointing right. His big round belly pushes far out to the right of the picture, overhanging his waistband, and his back is on the left of the picture. Both feet close together pointing right. His near arm is bent with the elbow out and the open hand at waist height.

gk.spin_back.words: seen from directly behind, his back to the viewer, standing with both feet close together in a dance spin. We see the back of his panama hat, the short black hair on the back of his head, his thick neck, the plain purple back of his shirt with its collar, the seat of his cream trousers and the heels of his teal shoes. Both thick arms are held out from his sides with the elbows bent and the hands open at waist height. His face is not visible.

bt.spin_side.words: in full side profile, her whole body facing the right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin. We see her smiling face in profile with one eye and her nose pointing right, her hair puff behind. Her apron lies flat over her thighs. Both feet close together pointing right. Her near arm is bent with the elbow out and the open hand at waist height.

bt.spin_back.words: seen from directly behind, her back to the viewer, standing with both feet close together in a dance spin. We see the round curly back of her hair puff, the back of her neck and closed collar, the plain deep teal back of her waistcoat over her ivory shirt, the plum apron strings tied in a bow at the small of her back, the seat of her dark plum trousers and the heels of her amber shoes. Both arms are held out from her sides with the elbows bent and the hands open at waist height. Her face is not visible.

mc.clap_apart.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart. Both short arms are raised out to the sides at chest height, elbows bent, with the hands held wide apart and the palms turned towards each other, about to clap. Both hands are clear of its round body, one at each side of the picture, below the head.

mc.clap_together_front.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart, clapping in front of its chest. Both upper arms angle in towards its round body and both forearms disappear in front of its chest, so the two hands are hidden by its body and only the shoulders and elbows show at its sides.

mc.clap_together_side.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart, clapping out to one side. Both short arms swing across to the right side of the picture and the two mitten hands meet palm to palm in a clap, beside its round body at chest height, clear of the body and below the head.

mc.clap_together_over.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart, clapping above its head. Both short arms reach up past both sides of its big head and the two mitten hands meet palm to palm in a clap above the top of the head, next to the antenna stem.

gk.spin_side2.words: in full side profile, his whole body facing the right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin. We see his face in profile with one eye, his nose and thin mustache pointing right. His big round belly pushes far out to the right of the picture, overhanging his waistband, and his back is on the left of the picture. Both feet are close together pointing right. His near arm hangs down at his side, the elbow slightly bent, with the relaxed curled hand beside his hip, far below his chest.

gk.spin_front.words: facing the viewer, standing tall with both feet close together, heels almost touching, about to turn in a dance spin. Both thick arms hang out from his sides at an angle, fingers relaxed and curled, hands low beside his hips.

gk.spin_34.words: turned three-quarters towards the right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin. We see his face turned to the right with both eyes and the thin mustache, one side of his shirt front with its teal panels, and his big round belly bulging towards the right of the picture. Both feet are close together pointing right. Both thick arms hang out from his sides at an angle, fingers relaxed and curled, hands low beside his hips.

gk.spin_back34.words: from behind and turned three-quarters, facing away towards the top right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin. We see the back of his panama hat, the back of his neck with short black hair, a sliver of one cheek and ear, the plain dark purple back of his shirt, and his big round belly just showing past his side on the right of the picture. Both feet are close together. Both thick arms hang out from his sides at an angle, fingers relaxed and curled, hands low beside his hips.

gk.flare_hat.words: facing the viewer, finishing a dance spin with a grand flourish, big proud smile, chin up, standing with feet apart and one heel forward with the toe up. His arm on the right side of the picture is swept high overhead, holding his panama hat aloft by the crown, so his black hair shows on his head. His other hand rests on his big round belly.

gk.flare_open.words: facing the viewer, finishing a dance spin with a proud ta-da, big smile, chin up, big belly thrust forward, leaning back a little. Both thick arms are flung wide and high out to the sides, palms open and up. One foot is stepped out to the side with the toe up.

bt.spin_front.words: facing the viewer, standing tall with both feet close together, heels almost touching, about to turn in a dance spin, smiling. Both arms are held out from her sides at an angle, elbows soft, hands open and low at hip height, as in image 1.

bt.spin_34.words: turned three-quarters towards the right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin, smiling. We see her face turned to the right with both eyes, one gold hoop earring, and the front of her waistcoat and apron from the side. Her feet are close together pointing right. Both arms are held out from her sides at an angle, elbows soft, hands open and low at hip height, as in image 1.

bt.spin_back34.words: from behind and turned three-quarters, facing away towards the top right of the picture, turning on the spot in a dance spin. We see the back of her hair puff, a sliver of one cheek and one gold hoop earring, the plain deep teal back of her waistcoat over her ivory shirt, the plum apron strings tied in a bow at the small of her back, with the apron cloth wrapping the front of her hip on the right of the picture. Her feet are close together. Both arms are held out from her sides at an angle, elbows soft, hands open and low at hip height, as in image 1.

bt.flare_high.words: facing the viewer, finishing a dance spin with a sharp flourish, big warm smile, chin lifted, her hip popped to the side. Her arm on the right side of the picture is flung straight up high with the fingers spread, and her other hand rests on her hip with the elbow out. Her foot on the left side of the picture is pointed forward on its toe.

bt.flare_dip.words: turned slightly to the right of the picture, finishing a dance spin in an elegant backward lean, looking back over her shoulder with a big smile. Her arm on the left side of the picture curves gracefully up over her head, and her other arm sweeps out and low to the right of the picture with an open palm. Her weight is on the back leg with the front foot extended on its toe.

mc.clap_apart2.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart. Both short arms are lifted out to the sides at chest height, elbows bent, with the two smooth round teal mitten hands wide apart and turned towards each other, about to clap, clear of its round body and below the head. The forearm on the left side of the picture has cyan bands, and the other forearm is plain ivory.

mc.clap_over2.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart, clapping above its head. Both short ivory arms bend upward close against both sides of its big head, and the two smooth round teal mitten hands press together palm to palm just above the top of the head, beside the antenna stem. The forearm on the left side of the picture has cyan bands, and the other forearm is plain ivory.

mc.clap_chest2.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart, clapping in front of its chest. Both elbows stick out at the sides of its round body and the two forearms go forward out of sight, so its hands and forearms are behind its body. We see only its back, its shoulder balls and both elbows on each side of its body.

bt.spin_34b.keep: Her ivory shirt stays buttoned up to the closed standing collar and her waistcoat stays buttoned high with gold buttons, fully covering her chest.
bt.spin_34b.words: turned three-quarters towards the right of the picture, her chest and the row of gold waistcoat buttons turned towards the right front, her face turned the same way with both eyes and a warm smile, one gold hoop earring. We see the front of her plum apron with its knot at the front of her waist. Her feet are close together pointing right. Both arms are held out from her sides at an angle, elbows soft, hands open and low at hip height.

bt.flare_high2.keep: Her ivory shirt stays buttoned up to the closed standing collar and her waistcoat stays buttoned high with gold buttons, fully covering her chest.
bt.flare_high2.words: facing the viewer, finishing a dance spin with a sharp flourish, big warm smile, chin lifted, her hip popped to the side. Her arm on the right side of the picture is flung straight up high with the fingers spread, and her other hand rests on her hip with the elbow out. Her foot on the left side of the picture is pointed forward on its toe.

mc.clap_release.words: seen from directly behind, standing on the ground, feet apart. Both short arms have just opened outward from a clap, held out at the sides at waist height, elbows slightly bent, the two smooth round teal mitten hands low and clear of its round body, below the head. The forearm on the left side of the picture has cyan bands, and the other forearm is plain ivory.
